SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

Conversions = Subscribers × CTR × Conversion Rate. Campaign Contribution = Conversions × Contribution Per Conversion. Campaign spend and fixed costs are excluded; this is not net ROI.

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS MODEL: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

Is this a net ROI calculation?

No. The model estimates contribution before campaign expenses. Subtract email-platform, creative and other campaign costs separately to assess net profit and ROI.
